profile.headline: building away
profile.summary:
Jason loves building. 

He has built CI/CD pipelines, robust APIs, and everything in between. He is a generalist known to get things done. He moves the needle on his projects and grinds to complete work efficiently and skillfully. 

He loves riding his bike, hiking and running outside. He is a wanna be Ironman and currently training for Ironman California this fall. He is married with two kids and enjoys spending time going on walks and dancing to Old McDonald with them.
